title: HLPowers
description: A datapack with 30+ unique abilities and permanent stat boosts.
body:
## HL Powers – Unlock Hidden Strength

**HLPowers** is a complete power system that changes how you fight, move, and survive – featuring **30+ unique abilities** to discover and master.

**Requires Minecraft 1.21.11 or higher.** Older versions are not supported.

---

### 🔓 How to Unlock the Power System

You can gain permanent access to **every ability** in two ways:

- Reach **Level 30** by gaining XP normally.
- Run the command: `/function hl_powers:power/enable`

Once unlocked, the entire power system is permanently active for that player.

---

### ⚔️ How Abilities Are Triggered

Different abilities activate through specific actions:

- **Using throwable items** – snowball, splash potion, trident, bow (arrow), eye of ender, etc.
- **Dropping certain items** – drop specific items from your inventory while powers are active.
- **Approaching special mobs** – get close to certain mobs while holding redstone in your offhand.

---

### 📊 Permanent Stat Boosts

Once the power system is unlocked, your base stats improve automatically:

- ❤️ **Health**
- 🛡️ **Resistance**
- 🍗 **Saturation**
- ...and more

No activation needed – they are always active.

---

### ✨ Unique Visuals for Every Ability

- Each ability has its own **particle effects** – no two look the same.
- Some abilities apply **custom status effects** with unique particles when hitting enemies.
- Certain abilities give you a **particle aura** while active.
- When you have unlocked the full power system, you will permanently carry a **special aura** – visible proof of your strength.

---

### 📖 Full Guide In-Game

All information is explained inside Minecraft. Run this command anytime:

`/function hl_powers:help`

---

### 🐞 Found Something Wrong? Want to Help?

Please report any bugs or issues using the **"Report issues"** link on the right side of this page (GitHub Issues). I read every report – your feedback helps improve the pack.

---

**Supports Minecraft 1.21.11+**  
No mods required – pure vanilla datapack.
